import random,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as M
def naive(n,A,tr,acc):
    block=[1 if acc[s] else 0 for s in range(n)]
    while True:
        sig={}; nb=[0]*n; k=0
        for s in range(n):
            key=(block[s],tuple(block[tr[s][c]] for c in range(A)))
            if key not in sig: sig[key]=k; k+=1
            nb[s]=sig[key]
        if nb==block: break
        block=nb
    return block
def part(block):
    d={}
    for s,b in enumerate(block): d.setdefault(b,set()).add(s)
    return frozenset(frozenset(v) for v in d.values())
random.seed(2024)
for t in range(3000):
    n=random.randint(1,50); A=random.randint(0,6)
    tr=[[random.randrange(n) for _ in range(A)] for _ in range(n)]
    acc=[random.random()<0.5 for _ in range(n)]
    blocks,bo=M.hopcroft(n,A,tr,acc)
    hpp=frozenset(frozenset(v) for v in blocks.values())
    npp=part(naive(n,A,tr,acc))
    if hpp!=npp:
        print("REAL MISMATCH",t,n,A); sys.exit(1)
print("hopcroft matches naive (set-of-frozensets) on 3000 DFAs up to n=50")
